about: Words on Project Home's Hall and Inbox that a first-time reader may not know, with a plain-words guess. Curated by reading the screens, not exhaustive. A word only counts when it is actually on a screen the newcomer saw.

terms.Estate: the whole set of projects (Home calls it "the Estate")
terms.DevErquest: the game-like view of the agents' work
terms.Quest Journal: the page that lists the agents' work
terms.expedition: one running mission of agent work
terms.Calling: a project or door that is asking for you
terms.art pick: a choice between pictures, waiting for you
terms.Core online: whether the Home service itself is up
terms.Tools: a folded group of other pages
terms.Hotbar: the row of nine shortcut buttons
terms.Look later: put this card off for now
